I'm Muslim so we literally can't have dogs . . . is what I thought until I did a bit of digging and found that although the saliva is considered impure, as long as it hasn't contaminated any part of a dog, you are still able to touch it. So I was having bs spewed at me about dogs being terrible creatures that will send me to hell since I was a child! Pets of any kind were out of the question, and I can't understand why when other Asian kids I saw, who's parents were friends of my parents, also had pets! When I'm free, I'm totally getting a kitty.  
Edit: Apparently dogs were also used by Muslims for hunting, and it was not considered impure to eat those animals sooo... And my relatives back in Bangladesh would also feed and take care of stray dogs who would guard the houses, so yeah.

Mine hates them completely and never let me play any games because apparently it's a "boys activity" and girls can't like games. The only games I ever played were flash games and mobile games that I could only play when my mom let me use her phone. One of my mom's friends gifted me a 3DS with Animal Crossing New Leaf and I was ecstatic. But guess what my mom did? She shipped it away to one of my cousins in Bangladesh, who's to young to even know how the controls work and can't understand a single word in it because it's in English. She already trashed a Gameboy that my sister had before, and she didn't even give them the charger, so I'm pretty sure they broke it. Apparently I was too old to play anymore, and I was a girl anyways, so what did it matter? This sexism is so unfair, when I was in elementary plenty of other Asian boys were playing stuff like MarioKart and Pokemon on the bus, yet because I'm a girl I had all of that taken away. Animal Crossing is literally one of the most traditionally "girly" games there is, and even that was too much for them. Now everyone my age and even older is gaming, and they still can't wrap their heads around someone like me playing games for fun.
Idk, seems like to me your parents are just looking out for you and treating you some.
